summary: Signature verification is configured in /etc/containers/policy.json: the default type reject is overridden per registry, insecureAcceptAnything skips verification (quay.io, docker.io), and a signedBy entry with keyType GPGKeys and keyPath set to your downloaded key enforces signatures for your automation hub server. GPG keys are the only supported keyType.
questions: How do I edit /etc/containers/policy.json to require signed images?
